 Kavita Dutt
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Nilesh Dave - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri K K Tiwari -Ga appearing on behalf of Advocate Ge
 Order

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's second bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as she is implicated in connection with Crime No.29/2023 registered at Police Station Crime Branch District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 30.5.2023.
Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as not presssed by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 14.5.2024 passed in MCRC.No.14221/2024.
3] The allegation against the applicant is that she and her husband mortgaged the registry of a flat to different persons, stating that there is no charge on the said flat.
4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and she has been lodged in jail since 30.5.2023.

It is further submitted that the main allegation is against the husband of the applicant, and the applicant, being a woman, deserves to be released on bail, and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a sufficient long time.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21060 2 MCRC-30865-2025 5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.
6] On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case diary and under the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty Five Thousand) with solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

8] Accordingly,
the application is allowed and disposed of.
